text: Should the attribute be emitted unconditionally, or be limited to specific targets and/or controlled by an opt-out setting?
options: Unconditional on all targets (the attribute exists on netstandard2.0 and net framework)
why_it_matters: If unconditional is intended, the #if guards and the README caveat are defects. If the guard is intended, the change fits the requirement. If an opt-out is wanted, a setting is missing.
